_readme: Curated factors added on top of the workbook Assumptions sheet. Rows whose id matches a workbook id override that row (the workbook value is kept in the notes). Add rows here to extend the material list (e.g. Cardboard, Glass).

factors.parameter: Road freight, articulated HGV >33 t, average load
factors.source: Base: UK DEFRA/BEIS 2025 (workbook). Low: GLEC Framework v3.0 (2023), articulated truck <40 t, Europe, tank-to-wheel, via Climatiq. High: DEFRA 50% laden.
factors.notes: GLEC value 0.058 kg CO2e/t-km fetched 2026-10-31; Climatiq marks it deprecated (replaced in data release 15). All values tank-to-wheel.

factors.source: No source found. Rounded order-of-magnitude placeholder.
factors.notes: Sea factors not available. Replace with GLEC sea/ro-ro default.

factors.source: No source found. Rounded order-of-magnitude placeholder.
factors.notes: Rail factors not available. Replace with GLEC rail default for the Baltic corridor.

factors.parameter: Empty return leg, share of loaded-leg emissions
factors.source: No source found. An empty truck uses roughly 60% of the fuel of a loaded one; rounded placeholder.
factors.notes: Only applied when 'Return trip empty' is on. Average factors (T1, GLEC) already include typical empty running, so this is for dedicated one-way shipments.

factors.group: Distances from Riga (approx. road km, not routed)
factors.parameter: Road circuity factor for city destinations (road km / great-circle km)
factors.source: No source found. Typical road-network circuity for European intercity trips is about 1.2-1.3; rounded placeholder.
factors.notes: City distances = great-circle distance from Riga x this factor. Partner destinations use the workbook distances instead. All distances are editable in the planner.

factors.parameter: Diesel use, 16-32 t lorry (Nordic Plast LCA)
factors.source: Bureau Veritas Latvia, LCA of Nordic Plast recycled pellets (Nov 2024, 2023 data)
factors.notes: Reference only. Not used directly; the model uses kg CO2e/t-km (T1).

factors.source: Bureau Veritas Latvia, LCA of Nordic Plast recycled pellets (Nov 2024, 2023 data)
factors.notes: Used for Latvian electricity when the Electricity method toggle is set to 'Latvian residual mix'. Other countries stay location-based (no residual-mix data).

factors.parameter: Recycling electricity, LDPE film (washing + extrusion + pelletizing)
factors.source: Herbold washing line 0.8-1.0 MWh/t; LIFE REPLAR 0.76-1.49 MWh/t (workbook). Cross-check: Zeilerbauer et al. 2024 report ~1 kWh/kg output.
Bureau Veritas Latvia, LCA of Nordic Plast recycled pellets (Nov 2024, 2023 data): 1.0876 kWh/kg pellets

factors.parameter: Material yield (pellets per tonne of film input), default
factors.source: Low: Nordic Plast LCA (1.5179 kg input per kg pellets = 0.66). High: Zeilerbauer et al. 2024 (~15% reject = 0.85). Base: midpoint.
factors.notes: Real partner yields not available except Nordic Plast. Agro film is dirtier than stretch film.

factors.source: Bureau Veritas Latvia, LCA of Nordic Plast recycled pellets (Nov 2024): 1.5179 kg sorted waste per kg pellets
Base: Plastics Europe Eco-profile (2014), as used in Zeilerbauer et al. 2024. High: Plastics Europe LDPE Eco-profile 2.13 kg/kg (workbook).
factors.notes: Higher virgin factor = larger avoided emissions.

factors.source: Zeilerbauer et al. 2024, RCR 209, 107807: 0.44 (Austrian grid, allocation), 0.48 (no allocation), 0.51 (EU grid)
factors.notes: Validation range only. 0.44 confirmed in the paper text; 0.48 and 0.51 are read from the paper's results figure.

factors.parameter: Substitution ratio (virgin LDPE replaced per tonne recycled)
factors.source: Zeilerbauer et al. 2024: many LCAs assume 0.9-1.0; 0.7 reported as break-even (Rajendran et al.). Critical assumption.

factors.parameter: Nordic Plast recycled pellets, total incl. distribution
factors.source: Bureau Veritas Latvia, LCA of Nordic Plast recycled pellets (Nov 2024, 2023 data): ~1.0 kg CO2e/kg
factors.notes: Benchmark only. Includes processes the model does not cover (water, additives, distribution).

factors.source: EU average end of life for plastic packaging, as reported in the Bureau Veritas Latvia LCA (Nov 2024)
EU average end of life for plastic packaging (Bureau Veritas Latvia LCA, Nov 2024)
EU average end of life for plastic packaging (Bureau Veritas Latvia LCA, Nov 2024)
Zeilerbauer et al. 2024, citing d'Ambrières 2019 and Edwards & Parker 2012: 3 kg CO2e/kg LDPE incinerated
factors.notes: No credit for energy recovery is applied.

factors.source: No source found. Plastics are assumed inert in landfill.
Plastics Recyclers Europe, EcoProfiles Recycled Plastics v1.0 (PRIMUS), cradle-to-gate, via Climatiq

factors.notes: Gate-to-gate: not directly comparable with cradle-to-gate values.
